content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (id 1914386) to the molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O). The template search gave mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply the template to the target molecule to get precursors.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id. Let's use that.
